tracker.kind.description: Where work packages are tracked: file, tasknotes, github, jira or linear. Empty means Phase 1 discovers the project's tracker each time

tracker.githubAuth.description: How the github tracker authenticates: gh uses the gh CLI's own login (a configured credentials.githubToken still wins); token requires credentials.githubToken

tracker.labels.description: Labels applied to every package entry the orchestrator creates

questions.path.description: Where question documents collect, relative to the work. Empty means a questions/ folder near the work

questions.human.description: Who answers the question documents, e.g. "Alex (product lead)"

models.judgment.description: Model for judgment-heavy drafting, e.g. opus. Empty means every worker inherits the session model

models.mechanical.description: Model for mechanical work, e.g. haiku. Empty means every worker inherits the session model

defaults.maxParallelAgents.description: How many workers run at once in one wave

defaults.maxPackages.description: How many work packages one parent task is split into at most

defaults.verifyOnDisk.description: Read every worker's output file before closing its package, instead of trusting its report

tracker.path.description: The tracker file (file) or the task folder (tasknotes), relative to the repo root

tracker.repo.description: The GitHub repository issues are filed in, as owner/repo

credentials.githubToken.description: Where a GitHub token with issues: write lives. A reference, never the token

tracker.site.description: The Jira site host, e.g. acme.atlassian.net

tracker.project.description: The Jira project key, e.g. LAUNCH

tracker.email.description: The Atlassian account email the API token belongs to

credentials.jiraToken.description: Where the Atlassian API token lives. A reference, never the token

tracker.team.description: The Linear team key, e.g. ENG

credentials.linearToken.description: Where the Linear personal API key lives. A reference, never the key
